ex.en: The baby crawled across the floor towards the door.
ex.zh: 婴儿从地板上爬向门口。

words.note: crawl 指手脚着地爬行，也指车辆缓慢行进。

ex.en: The two copies are identical to the original.
ex.zh: 这两份副本与原版完全相同。

words.note: identical 常接 to，表示“与…完全相同”。

ex.en: She pleaded with her parents to let her study abroad.
ex.zh: 她恳求父母让她出国留学。

words.note: plead 指恳求或法庭申辩；plead guilty 意为认罪。

ex.en: He has been waiting for a kidney transplant for two years.
ex.zh: 他已经等了两年，想接受肾移植。

words.note: kidney 指肾脏，常见搭配 kidney disease、transplant。

ex.en: The lights of the city gleamed in the distance.
ex.zh: 城市的灯火在远处闪烁。

words.note: gleam 指微弱闪光，也喻希望、兴趣的闪现。

ex.en: The city has announced an ambitious plan to cut pollution.
ex.zh: 该市公布了一项减少污染的宏大计划。

words.note: ambitious 指有雄心的，注意与 ambiguous（含糊的）区分。

ex.en: Her academic performance improved a lot this term.
ex.zh: 这学期她的学业成绩提高了很多。

words.note: academic 指学术的、学业的，作名词指大学教师。

ex.en: The spare room now functions as a small office.
ex.zh: 这间备用房间现在用作小办公室。

words.note: function 作动词常与 as 连用，表示“起…作用”。

ex.en: The book you want is out of stock at the moment.
ex.zh: 你想要的那本书目前缺货。

words.note: in stock 有存货，out of stock 缺货。

ex.en: He sneaked into the room without making a sound.
ex.zh: 他悄无声息地溜进了房间。

words.note: sneak 指偷偷地走或做，常与 in、out 连用。

ex.en: The contract was declared null and void by the court.
ex.zh: 法院宣布该合同无效。

words.note: void 指法律上无效，也指空虚；null and void 为固定搭配。

ex.en: In comparison with last year, prices have risen sharply.
ex.zh: 与去年相比，价格上涨了很多。

words.note: in comparison with 意为与…相比；by comparison 相比之下。

ex.en: There has been a surge in demand for electric cars.
ex.zh: 电动汽车的需求出现了激增。

words.note: surge 指猛增、涌动，常用 a surge in + 名词。

ex.en: I swapped my old phone for a newer model.
ex.zh: 我用旧手机换了一部更新的型号。

words.note: swap 指交换，常用 swap sth for sth。

ex.en: Making coffee is part of my morning ritual.
ex.zh: 煮咖啡是我早晨例行程序的一部分。

words.note: ritual 指仪式或固定不变的习惯做法，可数名词。

ex.en: The firm accepts no liability for damage to parked cars.
ex.zh: 公司对停放车辆受损不承担责任。

words.note: liability 指法律责任或债务，也指带来麻烦的人或事。

ex.en: The eggs will hatch in about three weeks.
ex.zh: 这些蛋大约三周后孵化。

words.note: hatch 指小鸟破壳孵化，也指密谋策划。

ex.en: He was a patriot who devoted his life to his country.
ex.zh: 他是一位把一生献给祖国的爱国者。

words.note: patriot 来自希腊语 patris（祖国）；patriotic 爱国的。

ex.en: Please tick the box next to your answer.
ex.zh: 请在答案旁的方框内打勾。

words.note: tick 指打勾或发出滴答声；tick the box 打勾。

ex.en: The team meets on a regular basis to discuss progress.
ex.zh: 团队定期开会讨论进展。

words.note: on the basis of 意为根据；on a ... basis 表方式。

ex.en: She works as a private tutor in the evenings.
ex.zh: 她晚上做私人家庭教师。

words.note: tutor 指个别辅导的教师，作动词常接 in。

ex.en: The senator spoke in favour of the new education bill.
ex.zh: 这位参议员发言支持新的教育法案。

words.note: senator 指参议员，senate 指参议院。

ex.en: The team won the cup for the third successive year.
ex.zh: 该队连续第三年赢得奖杯。

words.note: successive 指连续的；successful 指成功的。

ex.en: It is difficult to quantify the effect of the new policy.
ex.zh: 新政策的影响难以量化。

words.note: quantify 由 quantity（数量）变来，指确定数量。

ex.en: It is hard to reconcile these two conflicting views.
ex.zh: 很难使这两种相互冲突的观点协调起来。

words.note: reconcile 指使和解或使一致，be reconciled to 接受。

ex.en: I was tempted to buy the expensive coat but walked away.
ex.zh: 我很想买那件昂贵的大衣，但还是走开了。

words.note: tempt 指引诱、吸引；be tempted to do 表示很想做。

ex.en: The company has a legal obligation to protect customer data.
ex.zh: 该公司有保护客户数据的法律义务。

words.note: obligation 指法律或道义上的义务，比 duty 更强调约束。

ex.en: The novel is now available in paperback at most bookshops.
ex.zh: 这部小说现在在多数书店都能买到平装本。

words.note: paperback 指平装本，与 hardback（精装本）相对。

ex.en: The story is about the struggle between good and evil.
ex.zh: 这个故事讲的是善与恶的斗争。

words.note: evil 作形容词指邪恶的，作名词指邪恶、祸害。

ex.en: Such mistakes are rarely seen in professional writing.
ex.zh: 这类错误在专业写作中很少见。

words.note: rarely 是否定副词，置于句首要部分倒装。
